user.title: Set up Aqua Temp integration
user.description: Log in with your Aqua Temp or HiTemp account. The [HiTemp parameter guide]({guide_url}) explains every code and which ones are safe to change.

data_description.api_type: The app the account was created with
data_description.live_data: Before each poll, send the request the app sends while it is open (app_heartbeat), so the heat pump uploads its current values, and read the fault, version and switch codes it may then provide. Turn it off if the heat pump behaves differently with it.
data_description.update_interval: Minutes between reads of the cloud. The heat pump uploads its values every H32 minutes, so polling more often than that shows nothing new.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Aqua Temp password
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the password of {username}. Enter the current password to resume polling the heat pump.
